page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn6i.24xlarge is a bare-metal compute-optimized instance equipped with dedicated hardware acceleration. The server features 96 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor built on the x86_64 architecture. Memory capacity is provisioned at 384.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 4.0 GB per-core allocation. Virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

Hardware acceleration is delivered by four NVIDIA T4 GPUs providing an aggregate of 64 GB of VRAM (16 GB per GPU). Networking throughput reaches a baseline bandwidth of 30 Gbps. The instance provides no integrated local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for file systems and data persistence. Complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

The combination of four NVIDIA T4 accelerators with 96 host cores provides high multi-GPU compute density. Relative to single-accelerator setups, multi-GPU configurations offer cost efficiency for parallel inference and video encoding workloads, though the absence of onboard NVMe drives introduces network latency tradeoffs for high-throughput disk input/output operations.

Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn6i.24xlarge is suitable for distributed machine learning inference, real-time video transcoding pipelines, computer vision processing, and parallel computational workloads that utilize CUDA acceleration without requiring ultra-fast local scratch disks.
